## المرحلة 3: Templates للموافقات

### 3.1 لوحة تحكم الموافقات

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/dashboard.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load i18n %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <!-- العنوان -->
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <div>
            <h2 class="mb-1"><i class="bi bi-shield-lock text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
            <p class="text-muted mb-0">إدارة طلبات الموافقة والصلاحيات</p>
        </div>
        <div>
            <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_create' %}" class="btn btn-primary">
                <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> سير عمل جديد
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- الإحصائيات -->
    <div class="row g-3 mb-4">
        <div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm h-100">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <div class="display-5 fw-bold text-warning mb-2">{{ stats.pending_count }}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> طلبات معلقة</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm h-100">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <div class="display-5 fw-bold text-success mb-2">{{ stats.approved_today }}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted"><i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> معتمدة اليوم</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm h-100">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <div class="display-5 fw-bold text-danger mb-2">{{ stats.overdue }}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> متأخرة</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm h-100">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <div class="display-5 fw-bold text-info mb-2">{{ stats.total_workflows }}</div>
                    <div class="text-muted"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> سير عمل نشط</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row g-4">
        <!-- الطلبات المعلقة التي تحتاج إجراء -->
        <div class="col-lg-8">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-header bg-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                    <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-bell text-warning"></i> تحتاج إجراءك</h5>
                    <a href="{% url 'approvals:pending_list' %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">عرض الكل</a>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body p-0">
                    {% if pending_requests %}
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                        <table class="table table-hover mb-0">
                            <thead class="table-light">
                                <tr>
                                    <th>#</th>
                                    <th>المستند</th>
                                    <th>المبلغ</th>
                                    <th>مقدم الطلب</th>
                                    <th>الخطوة الحالية</th>
                                    <th>التاريخ</th>
                                    <th>إجراء</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                {% for req in pending_requests %}
                                <tr class="{% if req.is_overdue %}table-danger{% endif %}">
                                    <td>{{ req.pk }}</td>
                                    <td>
                                        <span class="badge bg-secondary">{{ req.get_document_type_display }}</span>
                                        <br><small class="text-muted">{{ req.document_number }}</small>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="fw-bold">{{ req.amount|floatformat:2 }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ req.requested_by.get_full_name|default:req.requested_by.username }}</td>
                                    <td>
                                        {% if req.current_step %}
                                            {{ req.current_step.name }}
                                        {% else %}
                                            -
                                        {% endif %}
                                    </td>
                                    <td>
                                        <small>{{ req.created_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</small>
                                        {% if req.is_overdue %}
                                            <br><span class="badge bg-danger">متأخر</span>
                                        {% endif %}
                                    </td>
                                    <td>
                                        <a href="{% url 'approvals:request_detail' pk=req.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">
                                            <i class="bi bi-eye"></i> مراجعة
                                        </a>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="text-center py-5">
                        <i class="bi bi-check-circle display-3 text-success"></i>
                        <p class="text-muted mt-3">لا توجد طلبات معلقة 🎉</p>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- آخر الإجراءات -->
        <div class="col-lg-4">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-header bg-white">
                    <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-clock-history text-info"></i> آخر الإجراءات</h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body p-0">
                    <div class="list-group list-group-flush">
                        {% for action in recent_actions %}
                        <div class="list-group-item">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                {% if action.action == 'approved' %}
                                    <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success me-2"></i>
                                {% elif action.action == 'rejected' %}
                                    <i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill text-danger me-2"></i>
                                {% elif action.action == 'escalated' %}
                                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-circle-fill text-warning me-2"></i>
                                {% else %}
                                    <i class="bi bi-circle text-muted me-2"></i>
                                {% endif %}
                                <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                    <div class="small fw-bold">
                                        {{ action.get_action_display }}
                                        {% if action.request.document_number %}
                                        - {{ action.request.document_number }}
                                        {% endif %}
                                    </div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">
                                        {{ action.acted_by.get_full_name|default:"النظام" }}
                                        • {{ action.created_at|timesince }} مضت
                                    </small>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% empty %}
                        <div class="list-group-item text-center text-muted py-4">
                            لا توجد إجراءات حديثة
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- روابط سريعة -->
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mt-3">
                <div class="card-header bg-white">
                    <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-lightning text-warning"></i> روابط سريعة</h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <div class="d-grid gap-2">
                        <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_list' %}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm text-start">
                            <i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> إدارة سير العمل
                        </a>
                        <a href="{% url 'approvals:branch_permissions' %}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm text-start">
                            <i class="bi bi-building-lock"></i> صلاحيات الفروع
                        </a>
                        <a href="{% url 'approvals:security_policy' %}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm text-start">
                            <i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> سياسة الأمان
                        </a>
                        <a href="{% url 'approvals:approval_history' %}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm text-start">
                            <i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i> السجل الكامل
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
````

### 3.2 قائمة الطلبات المعلقة

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/pending_list.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split text-warning"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:dashboard' %}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i> العودة للوحة
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- فلتر -->
    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
        <div class="card-body">
            <form method="get" class="row g-3 align-items-end">
                <div class="col-md-4">
                    <label class="form-label">بحث</label>
                    <input type="text" name="search" class="form-control" placeholder="رقم المستند أو اسم المستخدم..." value="{{ search }}">
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-3">
                    <label class="form-label">نوع المستند</label>
                    <select name="doc_type" class="form-select">
                        <option value="">الكل</option>
                        {% for value, label in doc_type_choices %}
                        <option value="{{ value }}" {% if doc_type == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-2">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">
                        <i class="bi bi-search"></i> بحث
                    </button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- الجدول -->
    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
        <div class="card-body p-0">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover mb-0">
                    <thead class="table-light">
                        <tr>
                            <th>#</th>
                            <th>نوع المستند</th>
                            <th>رقم المستند</th>
                            <th>المبلغ</th>
                            <th>مقدم الطلب</th>
                            <th>الفرع</th>
                            <th>الخطوة</th>
                            <th>التاريخ</th>
                            <th>الحالة</th>
                            <th>إجراء</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {% for req in page_obj %}
                        <tr class="{% if req.is_overdue %}table-danger{% endif %}">
                            <td>{{ req.pk }}</td>
                            <td><span class="badge bg-info">{{ req.get_document_type_display }}</span></td>
                            <td><strong>{{ req.document_number|default:"-" }}</strong></td>
                            <td class="fw-bold text-primary">{{ req.amount|floatformat:2 }}</td>
                            <td>{{ req.requested_by.get_full_name|default:req.requested_by.username }}</td>
                            <td>{{ req.branch|default:"-" }}</td>
                            <td>
                                {% if req.current_step %}
                                    <small>{{ req.current_step.name }}</small>
                                {% else %}
                                    -
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td><small>{{ req.created_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</small></td>
                            <td>
                                {% if req.is_overdue %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-danger">متأخر ⚠️</span>
                                {% else %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">معلق</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <a href="{% url 'approvals:request_detail' pk=req.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">
                                    <i class="bi bi-eye"></i>
                                </a>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% empty %}
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="10" class="text-center py-5">
                                <i class="bi bi-check-circle display-4 text-success"></i>
                                <p class="text-muted mt-2">لا توجد طلبات معلقة</p>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
        <div class="card-footer bg-white">
            <nav>
                <ul class="pagination justify-content-center mb-0">
                    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
                    <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}&search={{ search }}&doc_type={{ doc_type }}">السابق</a></li>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% for num in page_obj.paginator.page_range %}
                        {% if page_obj.number == num %}
                        <li class="page-item active"><span class="page-link">{{ num }}</span></li>
                        {% elif num > page_obj.number|add:'-3' and num < page_obj.number|add:'3' %}
                        <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="?page={{ num }}&search={{ search }}&doc_type={{ doc_type }}">{{ num }}</a></li>
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                    {% if page_obj.has_next %}
                    <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}&search={{ search }}&doc_type={{ doc_type }}">التالي</a></li>
                    {% endif %}
                </ul>
            </nav>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
````

### 3.3 تفاصيل طلب الموافقة

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/request_detail.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-check text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:pending_list' %}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i> العودة
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="row g-4">
        <!-- معلومات الطلب -->
        <div class="col-lg-8">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
                <div class="card-header bg-white">
                    <h5 class="mb-0">تفاصيل الطلب</h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <div class="row g-3">
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">نوع المستند</label>
                            <div class="fw-bold">{{ approval_request.get_document_type_display }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">رقم المستند</label>
                            <div class="fw-bold">{{ approval_request.document_number|default:"-" }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">المبلغ</label>
                            <div class="fw-bold text-primary fs-5">{{ approval_request.amount|floatformat:2 }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">مقدم الطلب</label>
                            <div class="fw-bold">{{ approval_request.requested_by.get_full_name|default:approval_request.requested_by.username }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">الفرع</label>
                            <div>{{ approval_request.branch|default:"-" }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">تاريخ الطلب</label>
                            <div>{{ approval_request.created_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">الحالة</label>
                            <div>
                                {% if approval_request.status == 'pending' %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark fs-6">قيد الانتظار</span>
                                {% elif approval_request.status == 'approved' %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-success fs-6">معتمد ✓</span>
                                {% elif approval_request.status == 'rejected' %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-danger fs-6">مرفوض ✗</span>
                                {% elif approval_request.status == 'escalated' %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-info fs-6">مُصعَّد ↑</span>
                                {% elif approval_request.status == 'auto_approved' %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-success fs-6">موافقة تلقائية ⚡</span>
                                {% else %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-secondary fs-6">{{ approval_request.get_status_display }}</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">سير العمل</label>
                            <div>{{ approval_request.workflow.name }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">الخطوة الحالية</label>
                            <div>
                                {% if approval_request.current_step %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-primary">{{ approval_request.current_step.name }}</span>
                                {% else %}
                                    <span class="text-muted">مكتمل</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% if approval_request.notes %}
                        <div class="col-12">
                            <label class="form-label text-muted">ملاحظات</label>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-light rounded">{{ approval_request.notes }}</div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- سجل الإجراءات -->
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-header bg-white">
                    <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i> سجل الإجراءات</h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body p-0">
                    <div class="list-group list-group-flush">
                        <!-- الخطوة الأولى: إنشاء الطلب -->
                        <div class="list-group-item">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-start">
                                <div class="me-3">
                                    <div class="rounded-circle bg-primary text-white d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px">
                                        <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <div class="fw-bold">تم إنشاء الطلب</div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">
                                        {{ approval_request.requested_by.get_full_name|default:approval_request.requested_by.username }}
                                        • {{ approval_request.created_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}
                                    </small>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {% for action in actions %}
                        <div class="list-group-item">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-start">
                                <div class="me-3">
                                    {% if action.action == 'approved' or action.action == 'auto_approved' %}
                                    <div class="rounded-circle bg-success text-white d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px">
                                        <i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i>
                                    </div>
                                    {% elif action.action == 'rejected' %}
                                    <div class="rounded-circle bg-danger text-white d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px">
                                        <i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i>
                                    </div>
                                    {% elif action.action == 'escalated' %}
                                    <div class="rounded-circle bg-warning text-white d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px">
                                        <i class="bi bi-arrow-up"></i>
                                    </div>
                                    {% else %}
                                    <div class="rounded-circle bg-secondary text-white d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px">
                                        <i class="bi bi-circle"></i>
                                    </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                    <div class="fw-bold">
                                        {{ action.get_action_display }}
                                        {% if action.step %} - {{ action.step.name }}{% endif %}
                                    </div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">
                                        {{ action.acted_by.get_full_name|default:"النظام" }}
                                        • {{ action.created_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}
                                    </small>
                                    {% if action.notes %}
                                    <div class="mt-1 p-2 bg-light rounded small">{{ action.notes }}</div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- إجراء -->
        <div class="col-lg-4">
            {% if can_act %}
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm border-start border-warning border-3">
                <div class="card-header bg-warning bg-opacity-10">
                    <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i> اتخاذ إجراء</h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <form method="post">
                        {% csrf_token %}
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">{{ action_form.action.label }}</label>
                            {{ action_form.action }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">{{ action_form.notes.label }}</label>
                            {{ action_form.notes }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="d-grid gap-2">
                            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">
                                <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> تنفيذ الإجراء
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% else %}
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-body text-center py-5">
                    {% if approval_request.status == 'approved' %}
                        <i class="bi bi-check-circle display-3 text-success"></i>
                        <p class="mt-3 fw-bold text-success">تم الاعتماد</p>
                    {% elif approval_request.status == 'rejected' %}
                        <i class="bi bi-x-circle display-3 text-danger"></i>
                        <p class="mt-3 fw-bold text-danger">تم الرفض</p>
                    {% else %}
                        <i class="bi bi-info-circle display-3 text-muted"></i>
                        <p class="mt-3 text-muted">{{ approval_request.get_status_display }}</p>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if approval_request.completed_at %}
                    <small class="text-muted">{{ approval_request.completed_at|date:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</small>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
````

### 3.4 قائمة سير العمل

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/workflow_list.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-diagram-3 text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_create' %}" class="btn btn-primary">
            <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> سير عمل جديد
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="row g-4">
        {% for workflow in workflows %}
        <div class="col-md-6 col-xl-4">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm h-100">
                <div class="card-header bg-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                    <h6 class="mb-0">
                        {% if workflow.is_active %}
                            <i class="bi bi-circle-fill text-success small"></i>
                        {% else %}
                            <i class="bi bi-circle-fill text-danger small"></i>
                        {% endif %}
                        {{ workflow.name }}
                    </h6>
                    <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_edit' pk=workflow.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">
                        <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                    </a>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <div class="mb-2">
                        <span class="badge bg-info">{{ workflow.get_document_type_display }}</span>
                        {% if workflow.apply_to_all_branches %}
                            <span class="badge bg-success">جميع الفروع</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">فروع محددة</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    {% if workflow.description %}
                    <p class="text-muted small mb-2">{{ workflow.description|truncatewords:30 }}</p>
                    {% endif %}
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                        <small class="text-muted">
                            <i class="bi bi-layers"></i> {{ workflow.steps_count }} خطوة
                        </small>
                        <small class="text-muted">{{ workflow.created_at|date:"Y/m/d" }}</small>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="card-footer bg-white border-top-0">
                    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {% for step in workflow.steps.all|slice:":5" %}
                        <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border" title="{{ step.name }}">
                            {{ step.step_order }}. {{ step.name|truncatewords:3 }}
                        </span>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% empty %}
        <div class="col-12 text-center py-5">
            <i class="bi bi-diagram-3 display-3 text-muted"></i>
            <p class="text-muted mt-3">لا يوجد سير عمل بعد</p>
            <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_create' %}" class="btn btn-primary">
                <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> إنشاء سير عمل
            </a>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
````

### 3.5 فورم سير العمل

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/workflow_form.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-diagram-3 text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_list' %}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i> العودة
        </a>
    </div>

    <form method="post" novalidate>
        {% csrf_token %}

        <!-- معلومات سير العمل -->
        <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
            <div class="card-header bg-white">
                <h5 class="mb-0">معلومات سير العمل</h5>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="row g-3">
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label">اسم سير العمل *</label>
                        {{ form.name }}
                        {% if form.name.errors %}<div class="text-danger small">{{ form.name.errors.0 }}</div>{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label">نوع المستند *</label>
                        {{ form.document_type }}
                        {% if form.document_type.errors %}<div class="text-danger small">{{ form.document_type.errors.0 }}</div>{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <label class="form-label">الوصف</label>
                        {{ form.description }}
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3">
                        <div class="form-check mt-2">
                            {{ form.is_active }}
                            <label class="form-check-label">نشط</label>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3">
                        <div class="form-check mt-2">
                            {{ form.apply_to_all_branches }}
                            <label class="form-check-label">جميع الفروع</label>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label">الفروع (إذا ليس الكل)</label>
                        {{ form.branches }}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- خطوات الموافقة -->
        <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
            <div class="card-header bg-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-list-ol"></i> خطوات الموافقة</h5>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                {{ formset.management_form }}

                {% for step_form in formset %}
                <div class="border rounded p-3 mb-3 {% if step_form.errors %}border-danger{% endif %}">
                    <h6 class="text-muted mb-3">
                        خطوة رقم {{ forloop.counter }}
                        {% if step_form.instance.pk %}
                        <span class="badge bg-secondary">موجودة</span>
                        {% else %}
                        <span class="badge bg-info">جديدة</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </h6>

                    {% if step_form.non_field_errors %}
                    <div class="alert alert-danger">{{ step_form.non_field_errors }}</div>
                    {% endif %}

                    {{ step_form.id }}

                    <div class="row g-3">
                        <div class="col-md-2">
                            <label class="form-label">الترتيب</label>
                            {{ step_form.step_order }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-4">
                            <label class="form-label">اسم الخطوة</label>
                            {{ step_form.name }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-3">
                            <label class="form-label">دور المعتمِد</label>
                            {{ step_form.approver_role }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-3">
                            <label class="form-label">معتمِد محدد</label>
                            {{ step_form.approver_user }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-3">
                            <label class="form-label">الحد الأدنى</label>
                            {{ step_form.min_amount }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-3">
                            <label class="form-label">الحد الأقصى</label>
                            {{ step_form.max_amount }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-3">
                            <label class="form-label">مهلة (ساعات)</label>
                            {{ step_form.timeout_hours }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-2">
                            <div class="form-check mt-4">
                                {{ step_form.is_active }}
                                <label class="form-check-label">نشطة</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% if step_form.instance.pk %}
                        <div class="col-md-1">
                            <div class="form-check mt-4">
                                {{ step_form.DELETE }}
                                <label class="form-check-label text-danger">حذف</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endfor %}
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success btn-lg">
                <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> حفظ
            </button>
            <a href="{% url 'approvals:workflow_list' %}" class="btn btn-secondary btn-lg">إلغاء</a>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>
{% endblock %}
````

### 3.6 صلاحيات الفروع

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/branch_permissions.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-building-lock text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:branch_permission_create' %}" class="btn btn-primary">
            <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> إضافة صلاحية
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- بحث -->
    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
        <div class="card-body">
            <form method="get" class="row g-3 align-items-end">
                <div class="col-md-6">
                    <input type="text" name="search" class="form-control" placeholder="بحث بالمستخدم أو الفرع..." value="{{ search }}">
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-2">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100"><i class="bi bi-search"></i> بحث</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
        <div class="card-body p-0">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover mb-0">
                    <thead class="table-light">
                        <tr>
                            <th>المستخدم</th>
                            <th>الفرع</th>
                            <th>افتراضي</th>
                            <th>عرض</th>
                            <th>إنشاء</th>
                            <th>تعديل</th>
                            <th>حذف</th>
                            <th>اعتماد</th>
                            <th>تصدير</th>
                            <th>الحد المالي</th>
                            <th>إجراءات</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {% for perm in page_obj %}
                        <tr>
                            <td><strong>{{ perm.user.get_full_name|default:perm.user.username }}</strong></td>
                            <td>{{ perm.branch }}</td>
                            <td>
                                {% if perm.is_default_branch %}<i class="bi bi-star-fill text-warning"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-star text-muted"></i>{% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_view %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_create %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_edit %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_delete %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_approve %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>{% if perm.can_export %}<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>{% else %}<i class="bi bi-x-circle text-danger"></i>{% endif %}</td>
                            <td>
                                {% if perm.financial_limit > 0 %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-primary">{{ perm.financial_limit|floatformat:0 }}</span>
                                {% else %}
                                    <span class="badge bg-success">بدون حد</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <a href="{% url 'approvals:branch_permission_edit' pk=perm.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></a>
                                <a href="{% url 'approvals:branch_permission_delete' pk=perm.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></a>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% empty %}
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="11" class="text-center py-5 text-muted">لا توجد صلاحيات محددة</td>
                        </tr>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

### 3.9 سجل الموافقات

````html
<!-- filepath: templates/approvals/history.html -->
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ page_title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-clock-history text-primary"></i> {{ page_title }}</h2>
        <a href="{% url 'approvals:dashboard' %}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i> لوحة التحكم
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- فلتر -->
    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-4">
        <div class="card-body">
            <form method="get" class="row g-3 align-items-end">
                <div class="col-md-4">
                    <input type="text" name="search" class="form-control" placeholder="بحث..." value="{{ search }}">
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-3">
                    <select name="status" class="form-select">
                        <option value="">كل الحالات</option>
                        <option value="pending" {% if status == 'pending' %}selected{% endif %}>معلق</option>
                        <option value="approved" {% if status == 'approved' %}selected{% endif %}>معتمد</option>
                        <option value="rejected" {% if status == 'rejected' %}selected{% endif %}>مرفوض</option>
                        <option value="escalated" {% if status == 'escalated' %}selected{% endif %}>مُصعَّد</option>
                        <option value="auto_approved" {% if status == 'auto_approved' %}selected{% endif %}>تلقائي</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-2">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100"><i class="bi bi-search"></i> بحث</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
        <div class="card-body p-0">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover mb-0">
                    <thead class="table-light">
                        <tr>
                            <th>#</th>
                            <th>النوع</th>
                            <th>المستند</th>
                            <th>المبلغ</th>
                            <th>مقدم الطلب</th>
                            <th>الحالة</th>
                            <th>التاريخ</th>
                            <th>الإتمام</th>
                            <th></th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {% for req in page_obj %}
                        <tr>
                            <td>{{ req.pk }}</td>
                            <td><span class="badge bg-secondary">{{ req.get_document_type_display }}</span></td>
                            <td>{{ req.document_number|default:"-" }}</td>
                            <td class="fw-bold">{{ req.amount|floatformat:2 }}</td>
                            <td>{{ req.requested_by.get_full_name|default:req.requested_by.username }}</td>
                            <td>
                                {% if req.status == 'pending' %}<span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">معلق</span>
                                {% elif req.status == 'approved' %}<span class="badge bg-success">معتمد</span>
                                {% elif req.status == 'rejected' %}<span class="badge bg-danger">مرفوض</span>
                                {% elif req.status == 'escalated' %}<span class="badge bg-info">مُصعَّد</span>
                                {% elif req.status == 'auto_approved' %}<span class="badge bg-success">تلقائي ⚡</span>
                                {% else %}<span class="badge bg-secondary">{{ req.get_status_display }}</span>{% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td><small>{{ req.created_at|date:"Y/m/d" }}</small></td>
                            <td><small>{{ req.completed_at|date:"Y/m/d"|default:"-" }}</small></td>
                            <td>
                                <a href="{% url 'approvals:request_detail' pk=req.pk %}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">
                                    <i class="bi bi-eye"></i>
                                </a>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% empty %}
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="9" class="text-center py-5 text-muted">لا توجد سجلات</td>
                        </tr>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
        <div class="card-footer bg-white">
            <nav>
                <ul class="pagination justify-content-center mb-0">
                    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
                    <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}&search={{ search }}&status={{ status }}">السابق</a></li>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% for num in page_obj.paginator.page_range %}
                        {% if page_obj.number == num %}
                        <li class="page-item active"><span class="page-link">{{ num }}</
```

## 2.2 Views (مكتمل ومُصلح)

````python
# filepath: accounts/views_advanced.py
"""
Views لنظام الموافقات والصلاحيات
"""

from django.shortcuts import render, redirect, get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib import messages
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db.models import Q, Count
from django.utils import timezone
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.forms import inlineformset_factory

from accounts.models_permissions import (
    UserBranchPermission, DataAccessRule, SecurityPolicy
)
from accounts.models_workflow import (
    ApprovalWorkflow, ApprovalStep, ApprovalRequest, ApprovalAction
)
from accounts.forms_advanced import (
    UserBranchPermissionForm, DataAccessRuleForm, SecurityPolicyForm,
    ApprovalWorkflowForm, ApprovalStepForm, ApprovalActionForm
)
from accounts.services import PermissionService, ApprovalService


# ============================================
# لوحة الموافقات
# ============================================

@login_required
def approval_dashboard(request):
    """لوحة تحكم الموافقات"""
    pending = ApprovalService.get_pending_approvals(request.user)
    today = timezone.now().date()

    stats = {
        'pending_count': pending.count(),
        'approved_today': ApprovalRequest.objects.filter(
            status='approved',
            completed_at__date=today
        ).count(),
        'rejected_today': ApprovalRequest.objects.filter(
            status='rejected',
            completed_at__date=today
        ).count(),
        'overdue': sum(1 for r in pending if r.is_overdue),
        'total_workflows': ApprovalWorkflow.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
    }

    recent_actions = ApprovalAction.objects.select_related(
        'request', 'acted_by', 'step'
    ).order_by('-created_at')[:10]

    context = {
        'page_title': 'لوحة الموافقات',
        'pending_requests': pending[:10],
        'stats': stats,
        'recent_actions': recent_actions,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/dashboard.html', context)


@login_required
def pending_approvals_list(request):
    """قائمة الطلبات المعلقة"""
    requests_qs = ApprovalService.get_pending_approvals(request.user)

    doc_type = request.GET.get('doc_type', '')
    if doc_type:
        requests_qs = requests_qs.filter(document_type=doc_type)

    search = request.GET.get('search', '')
    if search:
        requests_qs = requests_qs.filter(
            Q(document_number__icontains=search) |
            Q(requested_by__username__icontains=search)
        )

    paginator = Paginator(requests_qs, 20)
    page = request.GET.get('page', 1)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(page)

    context = {
        'page_title': 'طلبات الموافقة المعلقة',
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'doc_type': doc_type,
        'search': search,
        'doc_type_choices': ApprovalWorkflow.DOCUMENT_TYPE_CHOICES,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/pending_list.html', context)


@login_required
def approval_request_detail(request, pk):
    """تفاصيل طلب الموافقة"""
    approval_request = get_object_or_404(
        ApprovalRequest.objects.select_related(
            'workflow', 'current_step', 'requested_by', 'branch'
        ),
        pk=pk
    )
    actions = approval_request.actions.select_related('acted_by', 'step').order_by('created_at')
    action_form = ApprovalActionForm()

    if request.method == 'POST':
        action_form = ApprovalActionForm(request.POST)
        if action_form.is_valid():
            action = action_form.cleaned_data['action']
            notes = action_form.cleaned_data['notes']

            if action == 'approved':
                success, msg = ApprovalService.approve(pk, request.user, notes)
            elif action == 'rejected':
                success, msg = ApprovalService.reject(pk, request.user, notes)
            else:
                success, msg = False, 'إجراء غير مدعوم'

            if success:
                messages.success(request, msg)
            else:
                messages.error(request, msg)
            return redirect('approvals:request_detail', pk=pk)

    context = {
        'page_title': f'طلب موافقة #{pk}',
        'approval_request': approval_request,
        'actions': actions,
        'action_form': action_form,
        'can_act': approval_request.status == 'pending',
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/request_detail.html', context)


@login_required
def approval_history(request):
    """سجل الموافقات"""
    requests_qs = ApprovalRequest.objects.select_related(
        'workflow', 'requested_by', 'branch'
    ).order_by('-created_at')

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status:
        requests_qs = requests_qs.filter(status=status)

    search = request.GET.get('search', '')
    if search:
        requests_qs = requests_qs.filter(
            Q(document_number__icontains=search) |
            Q(requested_by__username__icontains=search)
        )

    paginator = Paginator(requests_qs, 25)
    page = request.GET.get('page', 1)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(page)

    context = {
        'page_title': 'سجل الموافقات',
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'status': status,
        'search': search,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/history.html', context)


# ============================================
# سير العمل
# ============================================

@login_required
def workflow_list(request):
    """قائمة سير العمل"""
    workflows = ApprovalWorkflow.objects.annotate(
        steps_count=Count('steps')
    ).order_by('document_type')

    context = {
        'page_title': 'سير العمل',
        'workflows': workflows,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/workflow_list.html', context)


@login_required
def workflow_create(request):
    """إنشاء سير عمل جديد"""
    ApprovalStepFormSet = inlineformset_factory(
        ApprovalWorkflow, ApprovalStep,
        form=ApprovalStepForm,
        extra=3,
        can_delete=True
    )

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = ApprovalWorkflowForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            workflow = form.save(commit=False)
            workflow.created_by = request.user
            workflow.save()
            form.save_m2m()

            formset = ApprovalStepFormSet(request.POST, instance=workflow)
            if formset.is_valid():
                formset.save()
                messages.success(request, 'تم إنشاء سير العمل بنجاح')
                return redirect('approvals:workflow_list')
        else:
            formset = ApprovalStepFormSet(request.POST)
    else:
        form = ApprovalWorkflowForm()
        formset = ApprovalStepFormSet()

    context = {
        'page_title': 'إنشاء سير عمل جديد',
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/workflow_form.html', context)


@login_required
def workflow_edit(request, pk):
    """تعديل سير عمل"""
    workflow = get_object_or_404(ApprovalWorkflow, pk=pk)
    ApprovalStepFormSet = inlineformset_factory(
        ApprovalWorkflow, ApprovalStep,
        form=ApprovalStepForm,
        extra=1,
        can_delete=True
    )

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = ApprovalWorkflowForm(request.POST, instance=workflow)
        formset = ApprovalStepFormSet(request.POST, instance=workflow)
        if form.is_valid() and formset.is_valid():
            form.save()
            formset.save()
            messages.success(request, 'تم تحديث سير العمل بنجاح')
            return redirect('approvals:workflow_list')
    else:
        form = ApprovalWorkflowForm(instance=workflow)
        formset = ApprovalStepFormSet(instance=workflow)

    context = {
        'page_title': f'تعديل: {workflow.name}',
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
        'workflow': workflow,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/workflow_form.html', context)


# ============================================
# صلاحيات الفروع
# ============================================

@login_required
def branch_permissions(request):
    """إدارة صلاحيات الفروع"""
    permissions = UserBranchPermission.objects.select_related(
        'user', 'branch'
    ).order_by('user__username', 'branch__name')

    search = request.GET.get('search', '')
    if search:
        permissions = permissions.filter(
            Q(user__username__icontains=search) |
            Q(user__first_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(branch__name__icontains=search)
        )

    paginator = Paginator(permissions, 25)
    page = request.GET.get('page', 1)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(page)

    context = {
        'page_title': 'صلاحيات الفروع',
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'search': search,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/branch_permissions.html', context)


@login_required
def branch_permission_create(request):
    """إنشاء صلاحية فرع جديدة"""
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = UserBranchPermissionForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            messages.success(request, 'تم إنشاء الصلاحية بنجاح')
            return redirect('approvals:branch_permissions')
    else:
        form = UserBranchPermissionForm()

    context = {
        'page_title': 'إضافة صلاحية فرع',
        'form': form,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/branch_permission_form.html', context)


@login_required
def branch_permission_edit(request, pk):
    """تعديل صلاحية فرع"""
    permission = get_object_or_404(UserBranchPermission, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = UserBranchPermissionForm(request.POST, instance=permission)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            messages.success(request, 'تم تحديث الصلاحية بنجاح')
            return redirect('approvals:branch_permissions')
    else:
        form = UserBranchPermissionForm(instance=permission)

    context = {
        'page_title': 'تعديل صلاحية فرع',
        'form': form,
        'permission': permission,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/branch_permission_form.html', context)


@login_required
def branch_permission_delete(request, pk):
    """حذف صلاحية فرع"""
    permission = get_object_or_404(UserBranchPermission, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        permission.delete()
        messages.success(request, 'تم حذف الصلاحية')
        return redirect('approvals:branch_permissions')

    context = {
        'page_title': 'حذف صلاحية فرع',
        'permission': permission,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/branch_permission_confirm_delete.html', context)


# ============================================
# سياسة الأمان
# ============================================

@login_required
def security_policy(request):
    """عرض وتعديل سياسة الأمان"""
    policy = SecurityPolicy.get_policy()

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = SecurityPolicyForm(request.POST, instance=policy)
        if form.is_valid():
            obj = form.save(commit=False)
            obj.updated_by = request.user
            obj.save()
            messages.success(request, 'تم تحديث سياسة الأمان بنجاح')
            return redirect('approvals:security_policy')
    else:
        form = SecurityPolicyForm(instance=policy)

    context = {
        'page_title': 'سياسة الأمان',
        'form': form,
        'policy': policy,
    }
    return render(request, 'approvals/security_policy.html', context)
````

### 2.3 URLs

````python
# filepath: accounts/urls_advanced.py
"""
URLs لنظام الموافقات والصلاحيات
"""

from django.urls import path
from accounts import views_advanced as views

app_name = 'approvals'

urlpatterns = [
    # لوحة التحكم
    path('', views.approval_dashboard, name='dashboard'),

    # الطلبات المعلقة
    path('pending/', views.pending_approvals_list, name='pending_list'),
    path('request/<int:pk>/', views.approval_request_detail, name='request_detail'),
    path('history/', views.approval_history, name='approval_history'),

    # سير العمل
    path('workflows/', views.workflow_list, name='workflow_list'),
    path('workflows/create/', views.workflow_create, name='workflow_create'),
    path('workflows/<int:pk>/edit/', views.workflow_edit, name='workflow_edit'),

    # صلاحيات الفروع
    path('permissions/', views.branch_permissions, name='branch_permissions'),
    path('permissions/create/', views.branch_permission_create, name='branch_permission_create'),
    path('permissions/<int:pk>/edit/', views.branch_permission_edit, name='branch_permission_edit'),
    path('permissions/<int:pk>/delete/', views.branch_permission_delete, name='branch_permission_delete'),

    # سياسة الأمان
    path('security/', views.security_policy, name='security_policy'),
]
